color.name: selector-border
color.notes: Shared border; do not replace with a new hard-coded template color.

color.name: selector-background
color.notes: Card and modal controls inherit this owner.

color.name: selector-text
color.notes: Labels and values must not create a parallel color source.

color.name: selector-selected
color.notes: Selected border/ring only; checked semantics and text remain independent of color.

color.name: shopify-swatch
color.notes: Only permitted runtime visual value. Missing data uses the existing neutral labeled state.

color.name: selector-tooltip-surface
color.notes: Retain only if contrast passes; tooltip is supplemental.

typography.name: selector-font
typography.notes: Do not hard-code Assistant or create selector-only branding.

typography.name: selected-label-size
typography.notes: Compact supporting value beside the option label for swatch groups; it shares the control row instead of adding a third vertical row.

typography.name: selector-line-height
typography.notes: Allows wrapped labels without a clipped line box.

spacing.name: selector-group-gap
spacing.notes: Reduced only between multiple option dimensions. Control hit targets and focus clearance remain unchanged.

spacing.name: pill-inline-padding
spacing.notes: Must yield to max-inline-size 100% for long labels.

spacing.name: neutral-swatch-inline-padding
spacing.notes: Preserves label legibility when no canonical color exists.

size.name: control-hit-target
size.notes: 44px at the default root size; minimum for every pill/swatch/radio visual.

size.name: selector-inline-size
size.notes: Selector cannot borrow width from price, quantity, Add, or sticky footer regions.

size.name: option-max-inline-size
size.notes: Long labels wrap inside the containing selector region.

size.name: image-swatch-size
size.notes: Visible 1:1 image inside a separate 2.75rem hit target. The visual can be compact without reducing the interactive target.

size.name: multi-dimension-row-minimum
size.notes: Each option dimension occupies one compact control row when its values fit; wrapping remains normal flow when they do not.

size.name: selector-height
size.notes: Replaces FPB Standard fixed selector-row assumptions.

size.name: interaction-layout-shift
size.notes: Selected, focus, hover, pressed, unavailable, and tooltip states may not change selector/card dimensions.

radius.name: selector-radius
radius.notes: Pills, dropdowns, image swatches, and neutral swatches reuse this owner.

radius.name: mapped-color-swatch-radius
radius.notes: Shape does not encode selected state alone.

border.name: selector-border-width
border.notes: Use box sizing so state changes do not change dimensions.

border.name: focus-outline-width
border.notes: Must remain visible and unclipped against every surface.

shadow.name: selected-ring
shadow.notes: May be normalized across FPB only if it fits existing merchant tokens and passes clipping QA.

z_index.name: ppb-tooltip-layer
z_index.notes: Must stay below modal/sheet owners and above its card surface.

z_index.name: fpb-classic-open-selector-layer
z_index.notes: Relevant only while the existing dropdown/list presentation remains; intrinsic matrices need no elevated card layer.

motion.name: selector-state-duration
motion.notes: Border and ring only; no geometry property transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion-duration
motion.notes: State feedback remains visible without transition.

component_alias.name: option-track-sizing
component_alias.value: intrinsic minmax using 100% container cap and control-hit-target floor
component_alias.notes: Exact implementation may use grid or wrapping flex after fixture measurement; it may not hide values or create a horizontal rail.

component_alias.name: multi-dimension-control-strategy
component_alias.value: In color_swatch or image_swatch mode, any dimension with no canonical Shopify swatch of that requested kind uses one native select; mapped dimensions retain their requested swatches.
component_alias.notes: Keeps Size x Color cards compact without guessing visuals, hiding values, or changing Shopify combination resolution. Explicit dropdown and pill modes remain unchanged.

component_alias.name: multi-dimension-group-layout
component_alias.value: label and selected swatch value share the first column; the select, pills, or swatches occupy the second column and wrap only when required
component_alias.notes: At narrow card containers the group returns to a stacked label-plus-controls layout; the selector never adds its own scrolling region.

component_alias.name: card-row-equalization
component_alias.notes: State changes produce zero height delta.

component_alias.name: selector-scroll-policy
component_alias.notes: Modal/sheet may keep its existing vertical scroll owner; selector adds no nested scroller.

component_alias.name: geometry-tolerance
component_alias.notes: No unintended shell/card/footer placement change beyond one CSS pixel; content-driven selector height itself is intentional.
